fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.body: The television is an Android TV. For French channels, open the Molotov TV app. Please log out of your accounts before you leave.
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.body: The radiators are self-regulating between 19 and 20°C: no need to adjust them, they switch off automatically at 20°C and restart when the temperature drops. An additional heater is available in the living room if needed. We can also adjust the radiators remotely.
fields.amenities.2.title: Heating
fields.amenities.3.body: Nespresso machine and filter coffee maker, plus a kettle in the kitchen. We provide coffee capsules and tea for your first night. After that, everything you need is just around the corner.
fields.amenities.3.title: Nespresso coffee
fields.amenities.4.body: The washing machine also has a tumble dryer function. Please reduce the load when drying: it cannot dry as much laundry as it washes in one cycle.
fields.amenities.4.title: Washer-dryer
fields.amenities.5.body: To get started — coffee capsules and tea (first night), 2 to 3 rolls of toilet paper. For your entire stay — organic cotton sheets and towels (4-star hotel equivalent), hair dryer, iron.
fields.amenities.5.title: What we provide
fields.amenities.6.body: Bins are located at the foot of the stairwell, at the back right of the corridor. Glass should be placed in the collection bins on the car park, at the corner of rue de la Pépinière and avenue Barthélémy Buyer. Please remove your rubbish when you leave — out of respect for our cleaning team.
fields.amenities.6.title: Bins & recycling
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.0: Did you press the padlock after entering the code? It's what validates your entry — without pressing it, the box won't open.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.1: The box unlocked, but did you pull to the side to open it? Unlocking doesn't open it automatically.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.2: After several wrong codes, the box goes into safety mode. Wait 1 to 2 minutes without touching it, then try again calmly.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.title: Having trouble opening the key box?
fields.arrival.steps.0.text: You're arriving at 22 avenue Barthélémy Buyer, on the Fourvière hill — opposite rue St Fiacre, near place de Trion.
fields.arrival.steps.0.title: Find the building
fields.arrival.steps.1.text:
Enter the code on the front door.
⚠️ This is an old door that can swell in the heat: if it doesn't open, pull it gently towards you to re-engage the latch.
fields.arrival.steps.1.title: The building's entry code
fields.arrival.steps.2.carousel.0.caption: Enter the building's hallway
fields.arrival.steps.2.carousel.1.caption: Take the staircase on the right
fields.arrival.steps.2.carousel.2.caption: On the 1st floor, the « Le Canut » door opposite
fields.arrival.steps.2.carousel_hint: Swipe the photos to follow the route →
fields.arrival.steps.2.text: Take the staircase on the right and go up to the 1st floor. It's the door opposite, with the nameplate « Le Canut ».
fields.arrival.steps.2.title: Reach the apartment
fields.arrival.steps.3.code_note: Your code · active until your departure
fields.arrival.steps.3.photo_caption: The key box, next to the apartment door
fields.arrival.steps.3.text: Place your palm on the keypad to turn it on, enter your code then press the padlock. Wait for the beep, then pull to the side to open the box and retrieve the key.
fields.arrival.steps.3.title: The key box
fields.arrival.steps.4.text: The key opens the door. Welcome to Le Canut ✨
fields.arrival.steps.4.title: You're here
fields.checkout_line: bins in the bin room, windows closed, key in the box
fields.house_rules.0.text: Staircase on the right as you enter, go up one floor — the « Le Canut » door is opposite.
fields.house_rules.0.title: 1st floor, no lift
fields.house_rules.1.text: Prohibited indoors. A detector alerts to smoke — restoration costs up to €65.
fields.house_rules.1.title: Non-smoking property
fields.house_rules.2.text: A decibel detector and camera monitor the landing (no conversations recorded).
fields.house_rules.2.title: No parties or gatherings
fields.house_rules.3.text: Please respect this: some guests may have allergies.
fields.house_rules.3.title: No pets allowed
fields.house_rules.4.text: Occupied building — please be considerate of neighbours.
fields.house_rules.4.title: Quiet after 10 PM
fields.house_rules.5.text: At the foot of the stairwell, at the back right of the hallway.
fields.house_rules.5.title: Bins at departure
fields.luggage.sub_arrival: Nannybag luggage storage at Part-Dieu · from €4.50/day
fields.luggage.sub_departure: Drop off your luggage and enjoy Lyon until your train · from €4.50/day
fields.parking.summary: Free parking in the surrounding streets
fields.parking.text.0: Drop-off zone: parking allowed (with warnings) on the street, or rue St Fiacre just opposite the building.
fields.parking.text.1: Free: parking often available on rues St Fiacre, des 4 Colonnes and de la Pépinière. Rue Pierre Audry: paid spaces. A public car park is located at the corner of rue de la Pépinière and avenue Barthélémy Buyer.
fields.recos.food.0.desc: Shaded terrace and dining room with fireplace, 300 m away. Refined bistro cuisine.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: Authentic Lyonnais bouchon (traditional restaurant), rue du Bœuf in Old Town — about 1.8 km, or by funicular.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: The « Les Collections » bar and « Les Téléphones » bistro table, towards the Basilica.
fields.recos.food.3.desc: Seasonal cuisine in the St-Just neighbourhood.
fields.recos.food.4.desc: Friendly address 700 m away, place Eugène Wernert.
fields.recos.food.5.desc: Takeaway pizzas, 550 m away (rue de Trion).
fields.recos.shop.0.desc: Convenience store 200 m away, rue de la Favorite.
fields.recos.shop.1.desc: Bread and pastries 200 m away, rue de la Favorite.
fields.recos.shop.2.desc: Pastry shop 600 m away, rue de Trion.
fields.recos.shop.3.desc: 91 rue de Trion. Opening hours displayed in the window.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: Crypt and panoramic views over all of Lyon, about 1.3 km (15-20 min climb). Stunning views from the esplanade.
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: Gallo-Roman museum and ancient theatres. Theatre access is free.
fields.recos.visit.2.desc: UNESCO-listed Renaissance neighbourhood, 15-20 min walk via the Gourguillon climb, or by funicular. Don't miss the traboules (covered passageways).
fields.recos.visit.3.desc: The Bartholdi fountain and Town Hall, in the heart of the Presqu'île.
fields.recos.visit.4.desc: Spectacular architecture at the tip of the Presqu'île, varied exhibitions.
fields.recos.visit.5.desc: 5 km riverside stroll, ideal on foot or by bike.

fields.transport.lines.2.text: Perrache in 15 min (bus C21 or 55); Part-Dieu in 45 min (metro B then D + funicular).

fields.transport.lines.3.text: Rhône Express to Vaulx-en-Velin La Soie, then metro A → D and funicular. Uber or taxi possible, similar duration.
